activity.title: We built cursor for dentists, check it out :) Cursor has an ai agent that has context on an entire codebase. Why can't dentists have an agent that has context on previous patient procedures, x-rays, & visits to streamline workflows? Once an x-ray + patient profile is uploaded, our ML segmentation pipeline segments teeth for ai-analysis + maps them onto a 3-d model (using 3.js), saving a lot of time! Dentists can ask our ai assistant (toothfairy) for more context on specific teeth + treatments + previous states of the tooth. More features: - clinical notes (from previous clinic visits) + treatment plans - pdf export generator w/ info on visit summaries, treatment plans, & clinical assessments/findings - side-to-side comparisons w/ previous x-rays to visualize how conditions have progressed Built w/ Michelle Jeon , Abe Kuk , Zain Khan in 36 hours! 🔗 Links: Github: https://lnkd.in/eVAxHkKR Devpost: https://lnkd.in/emugVRBN ...more ...more

The Copperlane (YC W26) team just spent a week under the 100°F Vegas sun to see where the future of mortgage is heading at Mastermind Summit . 🎲 Here's what we're noticing: 1. This industry is more complex than it looks from the outside, and that complexity isn't going away. For any technology to actually be useful to lenders, you have to start from the value it delivers to them. Earning a place in someone's workflow is harder than building the tech itself. 2. The devil is in the details. Many tech tools make big promises and can deliver on typical clean files. The real challenge is being able to handle the complexity of messier files, because that's where most of the real work and cost actually sit. 3. Trust is the real adoption barrier, and in such a regulated industry, lenders don't want a black box. They want to see why a decision was made and have an audit trail behind it. Explainability and transparency are key. Conversations like these shape what we're building at Copperlane. Our AI LOA Penny is designed to handle the incomplete and complex files. We've built Penny with safety first, and she's designed to show her full reasoning so lenders can trust what she's doing. Meet with us: https://lnkd.in/gW5z4R_i #MastermindSummit #MortgageTech #MortgageLeadership #MortgageAI #Copperlane #Mortgage copperlane.ai

The most expensive email in my inbox is from February 2024. A Cursor co-founder reached out to bring me onto their founding team. It didn't work out. This week, SpaceX acquired Cursor for $60 billion. Proximity to a $60 billion outcome teaches you something money can't: opportunity isn't random nor fair. It's a surface area. Success and the version of you that just missed it are often separated by just a few millimeters. Most people would file that under regret. I file it under proof. Because luck isn't random. Luck is a surface area - something that’s fully under your control. A Cursor co-founder emailed me because my surface was already big enough to catch his attention. That wasn't luck. That was consistency and showing up. I didn't convert that one. But the lesson wasn't "get luckier." It was "get bigger" Build more. Say it louder. Be so good they can’t ignore you. So now I'm obsessed with a different kind of millimeter. At Lucent (YC W26) , we build AI that watches your product's session replays 24/7 and detects where users are struggling. The next $60 billion door doesn't open for the person waiting beside it. It opens for the person whose surface area is so large the door has no choice but to find them. Building it now. Different door. My name on it this time.
